messages:
lena_cs: Quick heads up — AcmeCorp onboarding: usage jumped overnight, token burn > forecast. QBR on Tue. Can we do a quick spend triage and decide guardrails + a short slide for QBR?

tom_finops: Saw the alert too. Run rate ~ $3.1k/week (est). They have $9.8k remaining on prepaid credits. If trend continues, they'll overshoot in ~3 weeks.

mike_csm: Confirmed — onboarding scripts pushed more test traffic. I told their eng to pause perf run but they may resume today.

ana_enablement: For QBR slide we should show: baseline run rate, forecast w/ and w/o throttles, recommended action. I can draft. Any hard constraints from product side?

ryan_se: Recommend immediate per-route soft limit and prefix caching. Patch I can push: `route.acme.rate_limit: 150rpm` and `kv_cache.enabled: true` — will cut token consumption ~35% for their test workload.

billing-bot: Alert: acme-corp prepaid_balance=9800; burn_rate_est=3100/week; projected_exhaustion=3.1 weeks.

tom_finops: Nice. Also propose temporary quota cap at account level: `account.acme.max_tokens_per_day=1_200_000` until next billing cycle.

lena_cs: @ana_enablement can you own the slide? @ryan_se can you prepare the config diff and a one-liner about expected savings? I'll coordinate with the customer to pause non-prod runs.

ana_enablement: On it. Draft slide will include current spend, forecast, recommended throttles, expected % reduction, and an action checklist.

ryan_se: Pushed a canary with the soft limits to staging — logs look good. Snippet I used:
``
routes:
  - name: acme-ingest
    limit_per_minute: 150
    prefix_cache: true
``
Expect ~30-40% token reduction for repeated prompts.

mike_csm: I'll ask customer to stop scheduled load test tomorrow morning and confirm ack. Also will mention opt-in for dedicated capacity if they need predictable runway.

tom_finops: Also suggesting an alert rule: notify CS + FinOps at 75% credit usage and auto-throttle at 90%. I'll add that to the playbook.

lena_cs: Perfect. Let's sync 30m in 20 min to finalize slides and send prep email. Agenda: numbers, recommended config, customer ask, QBR slide deck owner. :thumbsup:
